paite: Thou inla, vak in, na vak ahong tung a, Toupa thupina na tung ah ahong suakta hi.
heading: Jerusalem Tunung Thupina
english: “Arise, shine; for your light has come, and Yahweh’s glory has risen on you!

paite: Ngai in, mial in leitung akhuh ding a, mial bikbek in mite akhuh ding ahi; himahleh na tung ah TOUPA ahong suak ding a, thupina na tung ah ahong kilang ding hi.
english: For behold, darkness will cover the earth, and thick darkness the peoples; but Yahweh will arise on you, and his glory shall be seen on you.

paite: Huchi in nam chih na vak lam ah ahong pai ding ua, kumpipate leng na hong suah vakna lam ah ahong pai ding uh.
english: Nations will come to your light, and kings to the brightness of your rising.

paite: Dak inla, na mit in en vialvial in, en in, avek un akikhawm ua, na kiang ah ahong pai uhi; na tapate gamlapi a kipan in ahong pai ding ua, na tanute ahong don ding uhi.
english: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see: they all gather themselves together. They come to you. Your sons will come from far away, and your daughters will be carried in arms.

paite: Huai hun chiang in na mu ding a, na vakta ding a, na lungtang kipak in aling ding, zatsak in a-om ding; tuipi a hauhsakna in na kiang lam ahon naih ding a, namte thahatna na kiang ahong tun ding ziak in.
english: Then you shall see and be radiant, and your heart will thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea will be turned to you. The wealth of the nations will come to you.

paite: Sangawngsau tampi'n ahon tuam ding ua, Midian leh Ephah gam a sangawngsau tuaite'n; huaite tengteng Sheba gam a kipan in ahong pai ding uh; dangka-eng leh begaw ahon po ding ua, TOUPA phatna thu atheisak ding uhi.
english: A multitude of camels will cover you, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah. All from Sheba will come. They will bring gold and frankincense, and will proclaim the praises of Yahweh.

paite: Kedarte ganhon tengteng na kiang ah a-omkhawm ding ua, Nebajoth a belamtalte'n na nna asem ding uh; ka maitam ah kipak in apaitou ding ua, ka thupina in ka pahtawi ding.
english: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you. The rams of Nebaioth will serve you. They will be accepted as offerings on my altar; and I will beautify my glorious house.

paite: Mei bang a leng leh vakhu amau tohlet zuan a leng duamduam bang kuate ahi ua?
english: “Who are these who fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

paite: Ama'n ahon pahtawi ziak in TOUPA na Pathian min ding leh Israelte Mi Siangthou a ding in na tapate adangka uh leh dangka-eng toh gamlapi a kipan a pi ding in pel lou in tuikulh gamte'n ahon ngak ding ua, Tarshish long liante'n masakpen atuh ding uh.
english: Surely the islands will wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring your sons from far away, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of Yahweh your God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he has glorified you.

paite: Huan gamdang mite'n kulhbaangte alemtou nawn ding ua, akumpipate un na nna asem ding uh; ka heh in ka hon sat a, himahleh ka hon deihsakna in na tung ah ka zahngai leuleu hi.
english: “Foreigners will build up your walls, and their kings will serve you; for in my wrath I struck you, but in my favor I have had mercy on you.

paite: Na kongkhakte leng hon in a-om gige ding ua; sun le zan in akhak kei ding uh; mite'n nam chih sum na kiang a ahon tawi ua, akumpipate uh ahon pi theih samna ding un.
english: Your gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night, that men may bring to you the wealth of the nations, and their kings led captive.

paite: Na nna sem nuam lou nam leh gam amangthang ding uhi; ahi, huai namte zaw suksiat in a-om ding uh.
english: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yes, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

paite: Ka Mun Siangthou zem ding in Lebanon thupina na kiang ah ahong pai ding, meilahte, phante, sing gelh chi ahong paikhawm ding ua ka khe sikna mun ka thupibawl ding hi.
english: “The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress tree, the pine, and the box tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

paite: Nang hon hihgentheite tapate kun in na kiang ah ahong pai ding ua; nangmah musit mite na khepek nuai ah akun ding ua, nang bel TOUPA khopi, Israelte Mi Siangthou Zion, ahon chi ding uh.
english: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you; and all those who despised you will bow themselves down at the soles of your feet. They will call you Yahweh’s City, the Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

paite: Kuamah veh ngei louh khopi, paisan leh huat a na om sang in tangtawn suanpen, suan tampi kipahna ding in ka hon bawl ding.
english: “Whereas you have been forsaken and hated, so that no one passed through you, I will make you an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

paite: Namte nawitui na tep ding a, kumpipate nawi leng na tep ding; kei TOUPA zaw nang hon hondampa leh nang Tanpa, Jakob Mi Hat ka hi chih na hon thei ding hi.
english: You will also drink the milk of the nations, and will nurse from royal breasts. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, am your Savior, your Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

paite: Dal tang in dangka-eng ka hon la ding a, sik tang in dangka ka hon la ding, sing tang in leng sumbelsik, suang tang in sik; lungmuanna na heutu ding in ka sep lai ding a, diktatna nang hon phutmi ding in ka sep ding hi.
english: For bronze I will bring gold; for iron I will bring silver; for wood, bronze, and for stones, iron. I will also make peace your governor, and righteousness your ruler.

paite: Hiamgam a thilhih husa na gam ah zak ahita kei ding a, hiamgamna leh siatna husa leng na gamgi sung ah zak ahita kei ding; na kulhbaang Hotdamna, na chi zaw ding a, na kongkhakte leng, Phatna, na chi ding hi.
english: Violence shall no more be heard in your land, nor desolation or destruction within your borders; but you will call your walls Salvation, and your gates Praise.

paite: Sun a nang hon tan ding nisa ahi kei ding a; kha leng vakna ding in ahon vaksak sam kei ding; TOUPA bel nang a ding in tangtawn vaksakpa ding in a-om ding a, na Pathian leng na thupina ding ahi ding.
english: The sun will be no more your light by day, nor will the brightness of the moon give light to you, but Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and your God will be your glory.

paite: Na ni atumta kei ding a, na kha leng amangta kei ding hi; TOUPA tangtawn vaksakpa ahita ding a, na lusuun nite atawp ding hi.
english: Your sun will not go down any more, nor will your moon withdraw itself; for Yahweh will be your everlasting light, and the days of your mourning will end.

paite: Na mite avek un midiktat ahi ding ua, na gam aluah tawntung ding uh; pahtawi a ka omtheihna ding a amau a zung selkhia ka suan, ka khutsuak ahi ding uh.
english: Then your people will all be righteous. They will inherit the land forever, the branch of my planting, the work of my hands, that I may be glorified.

paite: Mi tawmpen sangkhat ahi ding ua, mineupen leng nam hatte ahi ding uhi, kei TOUPA'N ahunhun in ka tungsak pahpah ding.
english: The little one will become a thousand, and the small one a strong nation. I, Yahweh, will do this quickly in its time.”
